dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: Wow... I can't believe that those children really turned a martial arts technique into a dance... And it looks rather good, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you, too, of the Guhua Clan?

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: Ha! That lad Guhua probably wouldn't have the audacity to call me a disciple. Back when we were fighting the bandits at Guili Plains, he even... Forget it. That's all in the past now.

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: But this whole "Guhua Clan" business has nothing to do with the lad's sword skills. In fact, I enjoyed watching them during sword practice — quite the diversion, you understand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: Go, go. Be careful you don't lose your way around here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to be twiddling your thumbs a little here...

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: Hmm? What's the point of having eternity on your hands if you can't fritter away a little time?

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: That celestial being up in heaven has placed us here like a bunch of clay warriors. After all the characters I've met, and all the delicacies I've tasted over the millennia, what else is left for me to hanker after?

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: "Swordsmanship"? "Skills"? You flatter me. I'm not like that boy Guhua, with all that flowery talk of "rain-cutting" and "light-piercing."

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: All I know is how to stab someone with my spear or sword and how to dodge other people's attacks in turn. Nothing to brag about, and like fermented side dishes, not things you show off in polite company.

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: But, I definitely am the person you should be talking to if you're looking to learn how to make those side dishes! Those Remurian barbarians... they have no idea how to make proper fish sauce. First, you have to...

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: Ahem. Unfortunately, fish are a rare commodity here. I'll teach you again the next time I ask Castiglione to draw me some fish.
